summary:
AstroTrack is a solution to acting late. If you can see the symptoms, ahead of time and act on them before they get serious, that’s how you save lives.

That’s why AstroTrack constantly monitors astronaut health data, and predicts what is happening, why it is happening, and tells you how to treat it.
details: It uses python + fastapi + html for a simple development experience in the open-source world and for other software development built on top of AstroTrack. I used Zed IDE for development using built in python tools. My project is creative because it doesn't just satisfy the prompt. It tries to help everybody by giving the tools (API) to create a dashboard of their own, not only for space, but for hospital patients, among other things.
